allocation.gpu_model: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition

smoke.extra_iteration_purpose: Perturb model/optimizer, restore the earlier full checkpoint exactly, then prove finite updating continuation; no full simulator/RNG trajectory restoration claim.
smoke.required_health: Finite changed actor/critic, coherent optimizer/scaler counters, exact full checkpoint payload reload after a real perturbation, positive post-load actor/critic updates, all first-episode evaluations finite.

rsl_ppo.precision: FP32 parameters, Isaac default TF32 allowed
rsl_ppo.boundary_override: Shared executed-action clip1 replaces stock wrapper clip_actions=None; raw Gaussian samples/densities stay unchanged.

cuda_ppo.precision: FP32 cuBLASLt pedantic dense and FP32 state
cuda_ppo.timeout_bootstrap: Match actual RSL current-observation value convention

official_flashsac.precision: Torch FP16 AMP, FP32 master parameters
official_flashsac.n_step_override_reason: One-step returns align pristine authors fixed gamma^n with native effective gamma^k at real time-limit truncations without patching either implementation.

initialization.ppo: One canonical current-RSL actor/critic/std state per seed, loaded exactly into RSL and native PPO on both allocations.
initialization.flashsac: One canonical pristine authors actor/critic/target/BN/temperature state per seed, loaded exactly into official and native FlashSAC on both allocations.
initialization.flash_replay_warmup_actions: Both FlashSAC recipes execute uniform[-1,1] actions from a separate Torch generator seeded seed+90000 while replay is not ready, then use the actual stochastic agent API. Readiness is checked before action selection and after insertion for updates. The main prefix is98 uniform-action vector steps: first updates follow the insertion at zero-based step97; the first policy action is at zero-based step98.

schedule.balanced: Every recipe position once and every directed within-seed immediate predecessor once per allocation.
schedule.limitation: Cross-seed boundary transitions are not balanced. Initial compilation/cache states differ by chronological position and are retained in raw timing.

evaluation.settled_upright_time_fraction: sum(active_before_step AND abs(wrap(post_step_pole_angle))<0.2 for zero-based steps60..299)/(128*240)
evaluation.failure_mask: Each terminated/truncated first episode is masked permanently; later automatic-reset episodes never contribute. Early failure contributes zero upright time for all remaining budget steps.
evaluation.terminal_observation: Use pre-reset final_obs on done steps; never measure the auto-reset observation.
evaluation.clean_timeout: truncated AND NOT terminated on the first completed episode
evaluation.angle_denominator: Report wrapped angle/RMS over active first-episode steps with active-step counts; full-budget upright fraction and survival expose early failures.
evaluation.time_to_threshold: First checkpoint satisfying the predeclared gate; report the previous-to-current checkpoint/time interval, never interpolate. Initial success is left-censored at zero; no success by400 is right-censored.
evaluation.sustained_success: Also report whether the gate holds at both300 and400; do not replace primary first-crossing results selectively.
evaluation.process_scope: One fresh evaluation process per run, one evaluation environment reused for all seven checkpoints. Every checkpoint is loaded from saved native format.

timing.primary: Full training-process wall through final checkpoint, plus separately itemized complete evaluation-process wall; show their sum as matched end-to-end run protocol wall.
timing.startup: Imports, simulator/asset/env initialization, learner construction, initial-state loads, compilation/capture, learner warmup, initial checkpoint save.
timing.training_loop: All400 iterations including collection, learning, host metrics/logging and checkpoint overhead; do not silently trim compilation/first iterations.
timing.checkpoint_availability: Record process-relative monotonic time when checkpoint writes finish; do not claim durable storage without explicit fsync. Time-to-threshold uses this wall and cumulative recorded training-loop wall as separate axes.
timing.evaluation: Record environment startup, checkpoint load, policy inference/physics evaluation, metrics reduction and evaluation output IO separately where measurable.
timing.logging_and_io: Record checkpoint and metric serialization/write wall explicitly; identify nested/overlapping instrumentation and do not sum overlapping phase costs.
timing.installation: Runtime installation/source transfer excluded from per-run time; report allocation protocol wall separately from first smoke to final evaluation.
timing.smokes: Separate from production quality/speed aggregation, but retained with chronological startup/compile costs and full allocation protocol wall.
timing.probes: GPU telemetry/profiling outside primary iteration timings where feasible; never run a competing GPU process.
timing.inference: Actual deterministic evaluation policy forward time if recorded; do not call full environment-step time inference-only.

audit.optimizer_counts: Actual saved optimizer/device counters; attempted=completed+skipped per optimizer. PPO8000completed steps/run; SAC attempt counts derived from actual insertion/warmup schedule and saved per-step counters, not guessed from total transitions.
audit.amp: Nonzero skips are reported, not suppressed or automatically invalid; inconsistent counts, nonfinite learned state or no actor/critic updates fail health.
audit.checkpoint_reload: Every scored checkpoint must be loaded from disk for deterministic common evaluation. Smokes separately verify optimizer/scaler save-load continuation without adding production transitions.
audit.native_fresh_mode: Require active actor/critic fresh-gradient metadata with no fallback at untimed preparation/final/checkpoint snapshots, consistent with saved zero-plan metadata.
audit.missing_or_failed_run: Retain all raw outcomes and failure artifacts; never omit an unhealthy seed from aggregate quality. Report incomplete budgets distinctly.
audit.public_privacy: Only allowlisted derived metrics, public source links/hashes, GPU model and distinct-device boolean; no raw paths/UUIDs/internal hosts.

analysis.unit: Report each allocation separately with all four seed curves, mean and observed min/max, not confidence intervals.
analysis.pairing: Native/stock differences paired by seed within algorithm and allocation; also retain each individual outcome.
analysis.descriptive_speed_consistency: Call a native implementation consistently faster only when all four paired seed full-training-process wall ratios are strictly below1 on EACH allocation. This is descriptive, not a significance or noninferiority claim and never a workflow/publication gate.
analysis.paired_speed_outputs: For training loop, full training process and end-to-end training-plus-evaluation wall separately, report every seed ratio, wins/4, median paired ratio and observed min/max per allocation. Always accompany speed with every seed quality/success result; speed alone is not learning success.
analysis.aggregate: Optional eight-run descriptive summary must retain allocation labels; two hardware allocations and repeated same seeds do not establish broad statistical significance.
analysis.speed_quality_tradeoff: Compare transitions-to-threshold and actual wall-to-threshold, fixed-budget final quality, full training wall and complete protocol wall separately.
analysis.limitations: Small classic-control MDP, one chosen PPO recipe and one FlashSAC recipe. Precision, networks, optimizer/update budgets differ across algorithms. This is an implementation/recipe comparison, not an isolated algorithm or precision effect.
analysis.future_g1: Conditional future work only; no G1 run authorized by this protocol.
